pages.text: Pale roots rise around a person-wide hollow. Amber threads hang where the trunk should be. The opening resembles the terminal aperture, though no frame has been fitted to it. These notes call it a Stillwood Hollow: the charter’s
pages.title: Bring it home
The Stillwood Hollow
pages.text: After every checkpoint and required objective, step through the hollow or use its wood. Bring any required cargo. The party returns to its terminal and your personal Return Cache is filed at the Wayroot.

pages.title: What can be used again
pages.text: Samples become equipment, and a completed charter becomes a record the terminal can recognise. Check its offerings after a return. Some work needs several forms of preparation.

pages.title: What can be used again
pages.text: Open Return Cache at a Wayroot after extraction. Collect your supplies and bound knot, then choose one of the three finds. The Wayroot keeps unclaimed hauls for you.

pages.title: What can be used again
pages.text: Load a bound Return Knot and an Assimilation Essence into the Sap Jar. Supply a bucket of water and Resonance, or dock a charged Cell. The brew begins when there is space for its output. The finished sap remembers the knot's home.

pages.title: What can be used again
pages.text: Carry sap by bucket or send it through a Rootwick. The basin spends only sap from the selected well. Each purchase draws a small bundle from its pool. Hard and Brutal extractions unlock gear.
